questions.stem: All of the following statements are true regarding the pathogenesis of dilated cardiomyopathy except:

options.label: A
options.text: In genetic causes, a mutation in the TTN gene is common

options.label: B
options.text: Myocarditis can progress to dilated cardiomyopathy

options.label: C
options.text: Alcohol abuse can also cause dilated cardiomyopathy

options.label: D
options.text: Storage disorders can also cause dilated cardiomyopathy

questions.answerText: Storage disorders can also cause dilated cardiomyopathy
questions.solutionHtml:
Storage disorders can also cause dilated cardiomyopathy
  • False, Storage disorders result in Hypertrophic cardiomyopathy.


Robbins & Cotran Pathologic Basis of Disease, 10th Edition, Page No. 570

questions.stem: Naxos syndrome is associated with which cardiomyopathy?
questions.solutionHtml:
Arrhythmogenic right Ventricular Cardiomyopathy
  • Naxos syndrome is a disorder characterized by arrhythmogenic right ventricular cardiomyopathy and hyperkeratosis of plantar palmar skin surfaces specifically associated with mutations in the gene encoding the desmosome-associated protein plakoglobin.



Robbins & Cotran Pathologic Basis of Disease, 10th Edition, Page No. 572

questions.stem: Mutation of which gene is most commonly associated with hypertrophic cardiomyopathy:
questions.solutionHtml:
β-myosin heavy chain (β-MHC)

Robbins & Cotran Pathologic Basis of Disease, 10th Edition, Page No. 572, 573

questions.stem: All of the following statements are true regarding histological features of hypertrophic cardiomyopathy except:

options.label: C
options.text: Organised bundle of myocytes in sarcomeres

questions.answerText: Organised bundle of myocytes in sarcomeres
questions.solutionHtml:
Organised bundle of myocytes in sarcomeres
  • False, Haphazard disarray of bundles of myocytes ie disorganized, individual myocytes, and contractile elements in sarcomeres within cells (termed myofiber disarray)


Robbins & Cotran Pathologic Basis of Disease, 10th Edition, Page No. 572, 573

questions.stemHtml: A 45-year-old patient died of heart failure and after the autopsy, a histopathological feature of the cardiac wall is shown in the diagram to identify the type of cardiomyopathy:
questions.solutionHtml:
Hypertrophic cardiomyopathy
  • The given figure shows massive myocyte hypertrophy, with enlarged transverse myocyte diameters, haphazard disarray of bundles of myocytes, and interstitial and replacement fibrosis suggestive of  Hypertrophic cardiomyopathy


Robbins & Cotran Pathologic Basis of Disease, 10th Edition, Page No. 572, 573

questions.stem: Takotsubo Cardiomyopathy associated with emotional stress is a type of-
questions.solutionHtml:
Dilated cardiomyopathy
